newsitem.title: USA: AMA will endorse Sunbeam products - Times.
newsitem.headline: AMA will endorse Sunbeam products - Times.

text.p: The American Medical Association has agreed to allow its name to be used in endorsing a line of products made by Sunbeam Corp, the New York Times reported Wednesday.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
It is the first time the AMA has ever allowed its name to be used in endorsing a line of products, the paper said.
The products will be introduced with the AMA's seal late this year. They will include blood-pressure monitors, heating ads, thermometers and humidifiers, according to the Times.
Under the agreement, royalty payments potentially totalling millions from Sunbeam will go to the AMA.
The AMA will use the money for health, education and research programmes, the paper said.
Critics of the deal said that it would erode public confidence in the AMA, the paper reported.
